title: Mall dreams
content: Joined group awhile ago out of curiosity but (thought) I had never had a mall dream and then just dawned on me I have. Most common recurring is a very cool food court that is underground via a very very long, carpeted on all sides and ceiling, ramp. It's a secret place and all kinds of interesting food places. Always excited when it shows up. There's more at this mall but that's the interesting part.
